title: Revegetation Monitoring in Owens Valley, California: Type E Transfer and 1999 Plan Sites
description: Living open repository for Inyo County Water Department revegetation monitoring under the Inyo–Los Angeles Long Term Water Agreement. Includes Quarto dashboards and pipelines for (1) Laws Type E transfer sites (2003 plan: abandoned irrigated agriculture managed toward precipitation-dependent native communities) and (2) 1991 EIR / 1999 Revegetation Plan mitigation sites (2025 resurvey and historical summaries). Cover and composition goals are assessed with plan-specific rules; sustainability (recruitment) methods are documented as they evolve. Code, processed tables, and rendered reports are version-controlled; the GitHub Pages site is the working analytics surface. This Zenodo deposit is a citable snapshot of a tagged release.
